[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding your true private value is the dominant strategy: you win when the second-highest bid is below your value and you pay that second-highest bid. I will bid my value $13 to maximize expected profit given independent draws. Tie-breaking randomness is negligible; bidding truthfully protects long-run profit. ]
